title: KGARevion: An AI Agent for Knowledge-Intensive Biomedical QA

model.params_source: assumed (paper silent for API models; open models used Transformers defaults, Appendix C.3.1)

task.subset_rule: paper-defined split: all expert-tier multiple-choice questions of AfriMed-QA (Sec. 4.4/4.5); 2,000 is an estimate until the CSV is filtered
task.approximation: Item count comes from the public release; plain (non-CoT) E.1 variant assumed for Figure 6 (run the CoT variant as a sensitivity check per the resolution plan); option formatting inside {question} is not printed; some AfriMed-QA items have five options while the template names A-D.

items.source: intronhealth/afrimedqa_v2 (gated: accept terms; CSV afri_med_qa_15k_v2.4_phase_2_15275.csv, 15,275 rows)
items.filter_prose: question_type == 'mcq' and tier == 'expert' (column names are the best reading of the AfriMed-QA paper; unverified because the card is gated)
items.access_note: Hub parquet listing exists (default/train, one file) but the file answers 401 without an accepted-terms token: column names and the label format (letter vs option text) are unverified

prompt.source_location: Appendix E.1 'Prompts for Evaluating LLMs' (plain variant); the CoT variant inserts 'Let’s think step by step.' after the first sentence
prompt.verbatim: full; machine form: the options (format not printed) are rendered as 'A. ...' lines on their own line after the question text via a second slot {options}

placeholders_prose.question: items.input followed by the options as 'A. ...' lines (format not printed; extend letters to E for five-option items)

output.postprocess: strip, first standalone capital letter; none = incorrect

metric.name: accuracy
metric.definition: share of expert-tier MCQ items whose parsed letter equals the gold option
metric.original_location: Sec. 4.4 text and Figure 6, 'Pure LLMs' bar for GPT-4-Turbo

open_points: gated dataset: accept the AfriMed-QA terms with a HF token, then verify the column names (question, answer_options, correct_answer, sample_id, question_type, tier are a best reading), the label format (add items.label_map if correct_answer is an option text or an index rather than a letter) and the expert-MCQ count (n_items is an estimate of ~2,000).
the runner's hf loader has no token support (anonymous Hub requests) - a mirror at a direct URL or a token-aware fetch is needed.
notes: Dataset page exists (gated, cc-by-sa-4.0) but the column names and the expert-MCQ count could not be read without accepting the terms and downloading; est_calls assumes ~2,000 items.
